ablation.name: d6_style_consist_15ep
ablation.notes: D6: Intrinsic style consistency loss. Encodes z_hat1 (predicted endpoint) through model.intrinsic_style_cnn to extract gen_style_global, then matches via cosine similarity to ref_style_global (from style_latent). Creates DIRECT style gradient signal that SWD's marginal distribution matching does not provide. Uses only model-internal features (no DINO/CLIP → no prior contamination). Does NOT modify velocity head (avoids style-free zone). Root cause: SWD only matches distributions, style feature similarity is not directly optimized → DINO-sty capped at 0.476. w_style_consistency=1.0 (moderate, ~1/12 of SWD weight). Based on hp_simple_swd12_15ep + D1 Gram w=1.0 (adopted as base). Goal: DINO-sty >= 0.49, CLIP-S >= 0.715.
